en_breve.parrafo: Kuova is a preventive-health platform based in Madrid, Spain. It brings together how you feel every day, the data from your watch, ring or band and your lab blood and urine tests; it explains the results clearly and suggests a plan to improve, checked by measuring again. It does not diagnose or replace your doctor: it helps you understand your health and arrive at your appointment better informed.

datos.valor: Lab blood and urine tests, your wearables and your daily log
Watches, rings and bands that sync with Health Connect (Android); Apple Health coming soon
Medicine, physiotherapy, nutrition, training and midwifery
Data stored in the European Union; never sold
